{{Recipe}}

'''Nigerian fried noodles''' are a famous dish in Nigeria, consumed by all.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Instant Noodles|Instant noodles]]
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Onion|Onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|Bell peppers]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* [[Cookbook:Carrot|Carrot]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] thin
* Leafy green vegetables
* [[Cookbook:Stock Cube|Stock cube]]

== Procedure ==

# Bring a pot of water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Add the instant noodles, and cook until softened but still slightly firm.
# Drain the noodles.
# Heat a thin layer of vegetable oil in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]]. Add the onion, peppers, carrot, and leafy greens, and [[Cookbook:Stir-frying|stir-fry]] for 2 minutes.
# Season the vegetables with stock cube or the instant noodle seasoning powder.
# Add the cooked noodles to the vegetables, and stir-fry them until frothy.
# Lower the heat so the noodles can fry more slowly for a few minutes.
# Serve hot.
